name: Cenlar FSB
notes: Researched from public cenlar.com and loanadministration.com pages only. Sign-in (loanadministration.com/cenlarfsb): Username + Password, LOG IN, Forgot Username / Forgot Password, "Register Your Account" (verify by phone or email), chat for help. Homeowners welcome: online payment after registering, free AutoPay from checking or savings, pay by mail with the statement coupon, Cenlar Mobile app, paperless via Document Center, 1098 each January. Payment terms: Make a Payment and Autopay are free ACH from checking/savings; a one-time payment can be cancelled until 9 p.m. ET on its withdrawal date; start transfers 15 days before the due date; Autopay changes/cancellations take effect after at least 15 days from receipt of notice; cancel Autopay online or in writing (email/fax/mail). Payoff statements 877-7-PAYOFF (24/7). Mortgage assistance 866-300-8154. Customer service number from the catalog (1-800-223-6527). No published grace period or late charge (not modelled).

pay_online.note: Online payments are free and drawn from a checking or savings account. A scheduled payment can be cancelled until 9 p.m. ET on its withdrawal date.

autopay_cancel.note: Changes and cancellations take effect at least 15 days after we receive your request.

help.title: How to pay
paragraphs: Register your account, then use Make a Payment for a free one-time transfer from your checking or savings account. Start it at least 15 days before the due date, because transfers can take several days. You can also pay in the Cenlar Mobile app.
You can cancel a one-time online payment until 9 p.m. ET on the day it is scheduled to be withdrawn, by chat in your online account or by calling the number on your statement.
To pay by mail, follow the directions on your billing statement, write your loan number on the check or money order and include the statement coupon.

help.title: AutoPay
paragraphs: AutoPay is free and debits your monthly payment from a checking or savings account. It stays on until you cancel it, the loan is paid in full or you no longer qualify.
Cancel or change AutoPay in your online account or in writing by email, fax or mail to the Drafting Department. Changes take effect at least 15 days after we receive your notice.

help.title: Paperless statements
paragraphs: Enroll in paperless delivery from the Document Center. You get an email when monthly statements, tax forms, disclosures and escrow statements are ready.
Your Form 1098 is available each January. Payoff statements can be requested online (they appear in Documents within 24 hours) or at 877-7-PAYOFF at any time.

help.title: Mortgage assistance
paragraphs: Options may include a repayment plan, forbearance, a loan modification or a payment deferral. If you cannot keep the home, a sale, short sale or deed-in-lieu can help you avoid foreclosure. After a natural disaster, a three-month forbearance may be available.
Call Mortgage Assistance at 866-300-8154. For free housing counseling, call HUD at 800-569-4287.

extra.intent: You scheduled a one-time Cenlar payment and want to cancel it. Using the Cenlar help pages, find the latest time on the withdrawal date you can still cancel it. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Until 9 p.m. ET on the date it is scheduled to be withdrawn.

extra.intent: Using the Cenlar help pages, find how long after Cenlar receives your request an AutoPay change or cancellation takes effect. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: At least 15 days after Cenlar receives the notice.
